stage1.impression: A clean, noise-free exploded view of a milk-carton speaker with believable gloss red, birch rebates and detailed drivers, but it reads as a grey, low-contrast technical render: the white body sits close to the mid-grey sweep, the dark drivers float without grounding shadows, and the face with the cut-outs gets little light shaping. The layout is loose and left-heavy, with the red-and-white gable piece stranded at top right far from where it came from, and dead space at top left and bottom right.

blocking_9: Side-left white [300,280,440,680] sits at median 202-212, keeps its ~30-level top-to-bottom falloff, and nothing but highlights goes above 226 (now 194, lower half 183-193; the whole frame's p99 is 216).

Insert bowl face [1000,320,1040,370] is within dE 3 of #C62828 under one smooth graded sheen (now [186,65,64], dE 5.3, under a stacked 0.78-radiance reflection, with sky-dark streaks beside the veil).
The waveguide reads as a horn: the bowl opens up and away from this viewpoint, and the pale shell fills 9,056 of the insert's 17,498 px, so the bowl's concavity and throat do not read.
The pocket details the purpose asks for are legible: no boss bore can be made out in the pocket at 5x, and the pocket magnets are 33 px.

The drivers read as the named units: they are seen about 70 deg off axis (woofer surround 66 x 197 px), so the papyrus and aluminium cones are slivers, and the mid cone is one flat value (lum range 11.3).
The white lacquer looks lacquered: the side-left mirrors the ~0.3-radiance sweep over 84% of its pixels, so no reflection shows and it reads as matte board.
The floating parts are grounded by shaped shadows: today there is one 27-level smudge, 212 px wide (10-90), under the woofer and nothing else.

changes.problem: The side-left, the cabinet's largest face (79,923 px), sits below the white-lacquer band and reads light grey, and nothing in the frame reaches a clean white.

evidence.measured: median 194 (p5 181, p95 216); y-profile 215, 208, 202, 197, 193, 189, 186, 183; frame p99 216, only 1,217 px at or above 226 (1,171 on the front-baffle strip x 466-490, 46 on the fin); sweep 126-173; the front baffle already runs 18-23 levels above the side-left at matched heights

changes.expected: Side-left median ~205 (top bin ~226, bottom ~193, so the ~33-level falloff is kept). Front-baffle strip [466,240,490,620] p95 goes from 227 to ~234: it enters the PBR Neutral shoulder but keeps a ~10-level gradient. Sweep rises 8-10 levels (pool behind the parts 170 to ~180, wall left of the cabinet 126-138 to ~135-148) and frame p99 to ~226. The retouch's 0.5 lightness share pulls the reds' lift halfway back.

changes.problem: The hero bowl's red is veiled pink: its main face mirrors bowl_sheen stacked on the gloss panel's 0.47-radiance floor (the ramp's 0.3 low value), which lifts G and B from the swatch's 40 to 65.

evidence.measured: rgb [186,65,64], dE2000 5.28 vs #C62828, lum range 29; mirrors 'bowl_sheen over gloss' on 90% of its pixels (bowl_sheen 0.27-0.36, gloss 0.469 at median, i.e. the ramp floor); the edge strip [1040,320,1062,380], which sees bowl_sheen over the sweep, reads [184,33,33]; sky-mirroring streaks at [962,290,985,320] read G 30 beside the veil; gable front slope [380,90,470,240] reads [196,68,69] and mirrors the gloss panel on 55% of its pixels

changes.expected: Insert face goes to about [195,50,50] at this exposure (~[200,55,55] with c1), dE 3.5 or less. The radiance the face mirrors narrows from 0.15-0.78 to 0.15-0.5, so the dark streaks stop reading as crumples. bowl_sheen (round 12's c2) and the drivers-panel stripe are left as they are, so this does not reverse that fix. Gable front slope G median goes from 68 to ~58-62, its sheen graded up from zero at the panel's foot instead of sitting on a flat 0.47 floor. Only the gable, the insert and 1.5% of each trim ring mirror this panel.

changes.problem: The floating drivers are anchored only by a smudge: the floor_shadow lamp is 1.2 m wide at 2.4 m, so the woofer's shadow is a 27-level dip blurred over 212 px with no shape, and the mid's and tweeter's shadows fall inside it.
changes.expected: Penumbra at the woofer's height drops from ~0.19 m to ~0.07 m. The cone and frame block the lamp up to the flange line at x~750 (y~787), so in [720,780,800,795] the floor steps 26-30 levels within ~30-40 px instead of ramping 19 levels over 80 px. The open floor keeps its level, since the lamp still puts 1 W/m2 on its target and lights only the sweep. The cabinet's overhead shadow at its left base sharpens the same way.

out_of_scope.request: Give the waveguide insert's outer shell the insert's accent colour (the card colours the insert in the accent) instead of the pale grey it renders.
out_of_scope.why: The shell is 9,056 of the insert's 17,498 px at [180,182,184] (lum 181), brighter than the red bowl (lum ~90), so the frame's hero reads as a grey-and-red wedge and the eye lands on the shell before the bowl. It is the product's own material and is fixed.
